We try to make every city we enter a better place - and by that we mean making our customers happy, supporting local businesses, and creating earning opportunities wherever we go. 3 Marketing Manager (m/w/d) Vienna, fulltime, fixed-term 12 months

What you'll be doing

As a Marketing Manager, you'll be the driving force behind Wolt's local marketing initiatives - bringing our brand to life across cities, communities, and digital channels. You'll turn insights into creative campaigns, partnerships, and experiences that strengthen our local presence and drive growth across all business lines. This is a hands-on role where you'll get to blend strategic thinking with creative execution, while collaborating closely with local teams and regional marketing partners to make an impact that truly resonates.

Day-to-day in this role, you'll:

 * Lead and manage local marketing campaigns from concept to execution - ensuring they're engaging, effective, and true to Wolt's brand.

 * Build strong relationships with local partners and merchants to co-create marketing initiatives that drive visibility and mutual growth.

 * Develop and implement the local social media strategy, crafting authentic, relevant, and community-driven content.

 * Collaborate with local influencers to produce creative, high-impact content that connects with our audience.

 * Activate both organic and paid hyper-local initiatives such as events, guerrilla marketing, and partnerships with community brands.

 * Partner with the regional marketing team to ensure that local campaigns align with broader business goals and brand guidelines.

 * Track, analyse, and report on campaign performance - translating insights into actionable improvements.

 * Support campaign planning for new city or area launches, helping to build excitement and awareness in new markets.

Our humble expectations

 * Experience managing and executing marketing campaigns across multiple channels (social, partnerships, events, influencer).

 * Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, ideally across commercial, operations, and content teams.

 * Strong analytical mindset - confident in using data to measure campaign effectiveness and inform future strategies.

 * Hands-on experience managing social media content and community engagement.

 * Comfortable juggling both strategy and execution in a fast-paced environment.

 * Previous experience in food delivery, on-demand services, or e-commerce is a plus.

 * Good language skills in German and business-fluent English.

What we offer

At Wolt, you'll join a team that's fast-moving, creative, and collaborative - with plenty of room to make your mark.

You'll have the opportunity to:

 * Lead local marketing initiatives that directly shape Wolt's presence in your market.

 * Experiment with new ideas and see your impact fast.

 * Work with inspiring teammates across multiple functions and countries.

 * Grow your skills in a fast-paced, international environment where learning never stops.

Next steps

If this sounds like the challenge you've been looking for, we'd love to hear from you! Submit your application and our Talent Acquisition Partner will be in touch.

jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Pharma / Biopharma Industry

Your Responsibilities:

● Performance & Web: End-to-end management and optimization of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO (WordPress).

● Lead Pipeline: Structured qualification and handoff of marketing leads to our international sales team.

● Content: Creation of white papers, case studies, and web content tailored for B2B decision-makers.

● Budget & ROI: Ongoing monitoring and tracking of all campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experience: At least 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B digital marketing—preferably within an industrial, technical, or life sciences background.

● Tech Stack: Demonstrated proficiency with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, WordPress, and CRM platforms.

● Mindset: Strong technical aptitude to translate complex concepts into high-impact content.

● Languages: Native or full professional fluency in English (primary working language) alongside strong business-level German.

● Project Management: Proven ability to manage budgets, meet complex deadlines, and execute international trade show projects seamlessly.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

As a Hospitality Agent Front Office at The Cloud One Hotels, you embody the crucial role of being the initial point of contact for our guests, setting the tone with your appearance, whether it's extending a warm welcome at the reception or providing assistance over the phone from the front desk. - Guiding and supporting our guests seamlessly from check-in to check-out
- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas
- Engaging in effective communication with guests via phone and email, adeptly managing reservation inquiries and navigating through overbooking situations and alternative options
- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
- Organizational and administrative responsibilities across both the front and back-office areas
- Expanding your knowledge through collaborative interactions within our multicultural team, offering insights into various cross-departmental roles

- Educational background and/or professional experience in hospitality, gastronomy, tourism, or a keen interest in venturing into these fields
- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence
- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication
- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments
- Enthusiasm to actively contribute towards the successful establishment of The Cloud One Hotels across Europe
